item.title: Legacy and Expertise in Magnetic Drive Pumps
item.description:
Legacy and Expertise in Magnetic Drive Pumps
#

Founded in 1978, ASSOMA set out with a clear vision: to become a world-class manufacturer in the field of magnetic drive pumps. Over the decades, ASSOMA has established itself as a Hidden Champion within Taiwan’s mag drive pump industry, consistently focusing on customer-centric innovation, quality, and service.
